g.text: Class Diagram (Design) - BCK07 Pizza Component Type Management
+create(id: ComponentTypeId, name: ComponentTypeName, order: int, min: int, max: int | null): PizzaComponentType
+revised(name: ComponentTypeName, order: int, min: int, max: int | null): PizzaComponentType
+existsByOrder(order: int, excludingId: ComponentTypeId | null, tx): Promise<boolean>
Omitted fields retain their current values.
Explicit maxQuantity = null removes the upper bound.
Only maxQuantity accepts null; ? denotes an optional field.
The complete resulting state is validated before saving.
min >= 0; finite max >= min; null = unbounded.
revised() returns a validated candidate with the same ID.
Order uniqueness is a set-wide rule enforced at persistence.
Postgres adapter implements all operations shown here.
Search uses domain-owned criteria, independent of HTTP
Exactly one type when isPizzaComponent = true;
otherwise none. No ownership or cascade deletion.
